The single line $y = x + F(x)$ unlocked.zh:
单单一行的 $y = x + F(x)$ 便开启了深达 100 倍的网络。
          观察普通深层网络的失效模式：64 层的
          激活图崩塌为噪声；随后加入跳跃连接，
          再看同一个网络干净地完成训练。包含三个实时实验与一次
          损失曲面巡览。
The single line $y = x + F(x)$ unlocked.src:
The single line $y = x + F(x)$ unlocked networks 100× deeper.
          Watch the failure mode of plain deep nets as a 64-layer
          activation map collapses to noise, then add the skip and watch
          the same network train cleanly. Three live experiments and one
          loss-surface tour.

@@T0@@~20 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Dee.zh:
@@T0@@约 20 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@深度学习 · CNN · 优化@@T3@@

Before December 2015, conventional wisdo.zh:
在 2015 年 12 月之前，普遍观点认为更深的网络
          应当泛化得更好 — 直到你尝试训练一个
          普通的 50 层 CNN，发现它在 @@T0@@训练@@T1@@ 集上竟不如 20 层
          的版本，测试集就更不必提了。这并非过拟合；
          而是优化器的失效。He 等人将其称为 @@T2@@退化问题@@T3@@。
Before December 2015, conventional wisdo.src: Before December 2015, conventional wisdom said deeper networks should generalise better — until you tried to train a plain 50-layer CNN and watched it do worse than the 20-layer version on the training set, never mind the test set. That's not overfitting; it's a failure of the optimiser. He et al. called it the degradation problem.

The fix was a single line of code: chang.zh:
修复方法仅需一行代码：将每个模块从
          $y = F(x)$ 改为 $y = F(x) + x$。此时输出为该模块
          所计算的结果 @@T0@@加上@@T1@@ 一份该模块本可忽略的
          输入副本。这一微小改动使训练 ResNet-152 成为可能，
          其 ImageNet 级别的精度达到此前所有架构深度的 3 倍，
          并由此启动了现代深度学习的火箭。
The fix was a single line of code: chang.src: The fix was a single line of code: change every block from $y = F(x)$ to $y = F(x) + x$. The output is now whatever the block computes plus a copy of the input the block could ignore. That tiny change made it possible to train ResNet-152, ImageNet-class accuracy at 3× the depth of every prior architecture, and started the modern deep-learning rocket.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A res.zh:
@@T0@@一句话概括。@@T1@@
          残差模块不必学会正确的输出。它
          只需学会 @@T2@@残差@@T3@@ — 即叠加在输入之上的
          小幅修正。若某一层无内容可加，
          它可以输出零，输入便原封不动地通过。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n A res.src: The slogan. A residual block doesn't have to learn the right output. It only has to learn the residual — the small correction on top of the input. If a layer has nothing to add it can output zeros, and the input passes through untouched.

Watch activations die without skips.zh: 观察无跳跃连接时激活的消亡

Below: a tiny feed-forward stack at dept.zh:
下方：一个深度为 $L$ 的小型前馈堆叠。每一层为
          $h_{l+1} = \tanh(W_l h_l + b_l)$，权重随机初始化。
          普通版本就是这一递推。残差版本
          将其替换为 $h_{l+1} = h_l + \tanh(W_l h_l + b_l)$。
          滑动 $L$，观察各深度处的激活量级。
Below: a tiny feed-forward stack at dept.src:
Below: a tiny feed-forward stack at depth $L$. Each layer is
          $h_{l+1} = \tanh(W_l h_l + b_l)$, randomly initialised. The
          plain version is just that recursion. The residual version
          replaces it with $h_{l+1} = h_l + \tanh(W_l h_l + b_l)$.
          Slide $L$ and watch the activation magnitude at each depth.

Activation L₂-norm per layer. Solid teal.zh:
各层的激活 L₂ 范数。青色实线：残差堆叠。
            橙色虚线：普通堆叠。普通网络的曲线衰减至零
            （或爆炸）；残差堆叠则保持有界。
Activation L₂-norm per layer. Solid teal.src:
Activation L₂-norm per layer. Solid teal: residual stack.
            Dashed orange: plain stack. The plain trace decays to zero
            (or blows up); the residual stack stays bounded.

Gradient flow — the same story, backward.zh: 梯度流动 — 同样的故事，方向相反
Gradient flow — the same story, backward.src: Gradient flow — the same story, backwards

Backpropagation computes\n $\\f.zh:
反向传播将 $\frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial h_l}$ 计算为一连串
          矩阵乘积。在普通网络中，链条上的每一环
          都是某个接近非单位矩阵的 Jacobian 矩阵；它们的乘积
          迅速崩塌。在残差网络中，Jacobian 为
          $I + \frac{\partial F}{\partial h_l}$ — 单位矩阵加上
          一个小量。单位矩阵起保真作用；“加一个小量”
          会逐层累加梯度信号，而非将其相乘消去。
Backpropagation computes\n $\\f.src:
Backpropagation computes
          $\frac{\partial \mathcal{L}}{\partial h_l}$ as a chain of
          matrix products. In a plain net every link in the chain is
          some Jacobian close to a non-identity matrix; their product
          collapses fast. In a residual net the Jacobian is
          $I + \frac{\partial F}{\partial h_l}$ — identity plus
          something small. Identity preserves; "plus something small"
          adds gradient signal layer by layer instead of multiplying it
          away.

Below: gradient norm at each depth, trac.zh:
下方：从损失回溯至第 0 层，各深度处的梯度范数。
          残差网络的曲线大致平坦。普通网络的
          曲线则呈几何式衰减。
Below: gradient norm at each depth, trac.src:
Below: gradient norm at each depth, traced from the loss back
          to layer 0. The residual line is roughly flat. The plain
          line falls off geometrically.

‖∂ℒ/∂h_l‖ vs depth l, on a log scale..zh: ‖∂ℒ/∂h_l‖ 随深度 l 的变化，对数刻度。
‖∂ℒ/∂h_l‖ vs depth l, on a log scale..src: ‖∂ℒ/∂h_l‖ vs depth l, on a log scale.

Same dataset, same depth, same optimiser.zh:
相同数据集、相同深度、相同优化器。按下方
          @@T0@@开始训练@@T1@@；一块画布训练普通网络，
          另一块训练残差网络。普通版本在 $L \ge 16$ 时
          明显停滞；残差版本则能干净地训练至
          大得多的深度。
Same dataset, same depth, same optimiser.src: Same dataset, same depth, same optimiser. Press Start training below; one canvas trains the plain net, the other trains the residual net. The plain version visibly stalls at $L \ge 16$; the residual version trains cleanly to much greater depth.

@@T0@@step @@T1@@0@@T2@@@@T3@@\n.src: step 0 plain loss — residual loss —

Training loss for the two architectures,.zh: 两种架构的训练损失，相同数据、相同学习率。将 L 调至 64，观察差距如何急剧拉开。
Training loss for the two architectures,.src: Training loss for the two architectures, same data, same lr. Crank L up to 64 and watch the gap blow open.

Li et al. (2018) showed that residual co.zh:
Li 等人（2018）表明，残差连接会使
          损失景观变得平滑。我们渲染一个二维切片：在参数空间中
          选取两个随机方向，在网格上求损失值，
          并绘制等高线。普通网络的景观起伏多脊、遍布糟糕的
          极小值；残差网络的景观则是一个单一的浅碗。
Li et al. (2018) showed that residual co.src:
Li et al. (2018) showed that residual connections smooth the
          loss landscape. We render a 2-D slice: pick two random
          directions in parameter space, evaluate the loss on a grid,
          and contour. The plain landscape is ridged and full of bad
          minima; the residual landscape is a single shallow bowl.

Lighter regions are lower loss. Notice t.zh:
颜色较浅的区域损失较低。注意普通曲面有
          多个被脊分隔的盆地；残差曲面则
          在原点附近有一个宽阔的单一盆地。同一模型类别，
          仅一行代码之差。
Lighter regions are lower loss. Notice t.src:
Lighter regions are lower loss. Notice the plain surface has
          multiple basins separated by ridges; the residual surface has
          a single broad basin around the origin. Same model class, one
          line of code different.

Iterative refinement — what each block d.zh: 迭代式精化 — 每个模块在做什么
Iterative refinement — what each block d.src: Iterative refinement — what each block does

A useful mental model (Greff et al., Jas.zh:
一个有用的心智模型（Greff 等人、Jastrzębski 等人、
          Veit 等人）：每个残差模块对一个持续演化的表示
          作出小幅修正。“残差流”将输入
          原样向前传递；各个模块则是读写的
          外设，对其施加微调。
A useful mental model (Greff et al., Jas.src:
A useful mental model (Greff et al., Jastrzębski et al.,
          Veit et al.): each residual block makes a small correction
          to a running representation. The "residual stream" carries
          the input forward unchanged; blocks are read-write
          peripherals that nudge it.

That's also exactly the picture of a Tra.zh:
这恰好也是 Transformer 残差流
          的图景 — 注意力与 MLP 模块读取该流，
          加上自己的贡献，再将其传递下去。机制
          可解释性研究（Elhage 等人，2021）将这一
          流视为层与层之间实打实的通信通道。
That's also exactly the picture of a Tra.src:
That's also exactly the picture of a Transformer's residual
          stream — attention and MLP blocks read the stream,
          add their contributions, and pass it on. Mechanistic
          interpretability work (Elhage et al., 2021) treats the
          stream as a literal communication channel between layers.

@@T0@@What the model can do that a plain.zh:
@@T0@@残差模型能做什么而普通堆叠不能。@@T1@@
          残差堆叠可以 @@T2@@自行选择@@T3@@ 其深度：任何
          多余的模块只需输出 $\approx 0$，输入
          便直接通过。普通堆叠则必须充分利用每一层
          — 为此优化器还得从零学出一个
          恒等子网络。
@@T0@@What the model can do that a plain.src: What the model can do that a plain stack cannot. A residual stack can choose its own depth: any unnecessary block just outputs $\approx 0$ and the input passes through. A plain stack has to use every layer fully — and the optimiser has to learn an identity subnetwork from scratch to do so.

@@T0@@ResNet-v1.@@T1@@ $y = \\mathrm{ReL.zh:
@@T0@@ResNet-v1。@@T1@@ $y = \mathrm{ReLU}(F(x) + x)$。
            原始版本，在 ImageNet 上仍然表现强劲。
@@T0@@ResNet-v1.@@T1@@ $y = \\mathrm{ReL.src: ResNet-v1. $y = \mathrm{ReLU}(F(x) + x)$. Original, still strong on ImageNet.

@@T0@@Pre-activation ResNet.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@预激活 ResNet。@@T1@@
            $y = F(x) + x$，并将 BN→ReLU 置于卷积 @@T2@@之前@@T3@@。
            梯度流动更干净；适用于极深的堆叠
            （1000 层以上）。
@@T0@@Pre-activation ResNet.@@T1@@\n.src: Pre-activation ResNet. $y = F(x) + x$ with the BN→ReLU before the conv. Cleaner gradient flow; preferred for very deep stacks (1000+ layers).

@@T0@@DenseNet.@@T1@@ Concatenate every.zh:
@@T0@@DenseNet。@@T1@@ 将此前所有输出
            拼接而非相加。参数效率更高，
            但因内存原因在硬件上略慢。
@@T0@@DenseNet.@@T1@@ Concatenate every.src: DenseNet. Concatenate every previous output instead of summing. More parameter-efficient, slightly slower on hardware due to memory.

@@T0@@Highway / gated residuals.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@Highway / 门控残差。@@T1@@
            $y = T(x) \odot F(x) + (1 - T(x)) \odot x$，其中 $T$ 为可学习的
            门。ResNet 是其 $T = 1$ 的特例。LSTM 中
            也有类似的思想。
@@T0@@Highway / gated residuals.@@T1@@\n.src: Highway / gated residuals. $y = T(x) \odot F(x) + (1 - T(x)) \odot x$ with a learned gate $T$. ResNet is the special case $T = 1$. Recovers a similar idea in LSTMs.

@@T0@@Transformer residuals.@@T1@@ Every.zh:
@@T0@@Transformer 的残差。@@T1@@ 每个注意力
            模块与 MLP 模块都在读写一个残差流。其
            数学依据与 ResNet 完全相同。
@@T0@@Transformer residuals.@@T1@@ Every.src: Transformer residuals. Every attention and MLP block reads-and-writes a residual stream. The mathematical justification is identical to ResNet's.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n O.zh:
@@T0@@最后总结。@@T1@@
          一行代码 — “并把输入加回来” — 堪称
          深度学习中的活字印刷术。若无
          残差，就没有 ResNet-152，没有 BERT，也没有任何 GPT。每当
          你堆叠超过约 10 层而它依然正常工作时，
          你就在使用这一技巧。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n O.src: Final takeaway. One line of code — "and add the input back" — was the deep-learning equivalent of the printing press. Without residuals, no ResNet-152, no BERT, no GPT-anything. Every time you stack more than ~10 layers and it just works, you're using this trick.

Why the residual stream view unlocks Tra.zh: 残差流视角为何能打通对 Transformer 的理解
Why the residual stream view unlocks Tra.src: Why the residual stream view unlocks Transformers

Modern transformers are best understood.zh: 现代 Transformer 最好被理解为 @@T0@@残差流@@T1@@（Elhage 等人，2021，Anthropic 可解释性研究）。每一层从高维残差流中读取信息，计算一个增量，再将其写回。第 $\ell$ 层的输出为
Modern transformers are best understood.src: Modern transformers are best understood as residual streams (Elhage et al., 2021, Anthropic interpretability). Each layer reads from a high-dimensional residual stream, computes a delta, and writes it back. Layer $\ell$'s output is

Three consequences of this view:.zh: 这一视角带来三点推论：

@@T0@@Layers communicate through the str.zh: @@T0@@各层通过该流进行通信。@@T1@@ 第 12 层能读到第 3 层所写的内容，因为残差流将其原样传递了过来（扣除后续各层所添加的部分）。
@@T0@@Layers communicate through the str.src: Layers communicate through the stream. Layer 12 can read what layer 3 wrote because the residual stream carried it through unchanged (modulo whatever later layers added).

@@T0@@The stream is a \"shared workspace.zh: @@T0@@该流是一个“共享工作区”。@@T1@@ 不同的头 / MLP 各自专精于写入不同“种类”的信息；下游各层读取其中相关的内容。机制可解释性论文识别出了跨越多个层的“归纳头”“后继头”“字母计数回路”。
@@T0@@The stream is a \"shared workspace.src: The stream is a "shared workspace". Different heads / MLPs specialise in writing different "kinds" of information; downstream layers read what's relevant. Mech-interp papers identify "induction heads", "successor heads", "letter-counting circuits" that span multiple layers.

@@T0@@LayerNorm is the gate.@@T1@@ Pre-n.zh: @@T0@@LayerNorm 充当闸门。@@T1@@ 前置归一化的 Transformer（在注意力 / MLP 之前归一化）之所以优于后置归一化，正是因为前置归一化保留了残差的恒等路径。后置归一化的 Transformer 需要预热；前置归一化则不需要。
@@T0@@LayerNorm is the gate.@@T1@@ Pre-n.src: LayerNorm is the gate. Pre-norm transformers (norm before attention/MLP) work better than post-norm precisely because pre-norm preserves the residual identity path. Post-norm transformers need warmup; pre-norm don't.

Where residuals can hurt.zh: 残差可能带来危害之处

Three failure modes to know:.zh: 有三种值得了解的失效模式：

@@T0@@Representation rank collapse.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@表示秩崩塌。@@T1@@ 堆叠许多增量相近的残差模块，
            可能把残差流推入一个低秩流形（Dong 等人，2021）。症状：
            靠后各层的注意力头全部关注同一个词元，收敛缓慢。修复：
            更强的正则化、深度缩放，或使每个模块倾向于写入
            不同内容的初始化方式。
@@T0@@Representation rank collapse.@@T1@.src: Representation rank collapse. Stacking many residual blocks with similar deltas can push the residual stream into a low-rank manifold (Dong et al., 2021). Symptoms: late-layer attention heads all attending to the same token, slow convergence. Fix: stronger regularisation, depth scaling, or initialisation that biases each block to write something distinct.

@@T0@@\"Free path\" overuse.@@T1@@ If a.zh: @@T0@@“自由通道”的过度使用。@@T1@@ 若某个模块持续输出接近零，则参数被浪费；若每个模块都输出很强，则残差流被噪声主导。健康的 Transformer 居于二者之间，但训练期间检查各层输出范数是值得的。
@@T0@@\"Free path\" overuse.@@T1@@ If a.src: "Free path" overuse. If a block consistently outputs near-zero, you've wasted parameters; if every block outputs strongly, the residual stream is dominated by noise. Healthy transformers sit in between, but it's worth checking layer-output norms during training.

@@T0@@Skip-connection memory cost.@@T1@@.zh:
@@T0@@跳跃连接的内存代价。@@T1@@ 为完成加法，原始输入必须在整个模块中
            一直保留；在某些实现中这会使激活内存翻倍。可逆变体
            （RevNet）在反向传播时重新计算激活；实践中很少需要。
@@T0@@Skip-connection memory cost.@@T1@@.src: Skip-connection memory cost. The original input has to be kept around through the block for the addition; this doubles activation memory in some implementations. Reversible variants (RevNet) recompute activations on the backward pass; rarely needed in practice.

@@T0@@He, Zhang, Ren, Sun (2015)@@T1@@ &.zh: @@T0@@He, Zhang, Ren, Sun（2015）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition.@@T3@@ ResNet 的原始论文。
@@T0@@He, Zhang, Ren, Sun (2015)@@T1@@ &.src: He, Zhang, Ren, Sun (2015) — Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition. The ResNet paper.

@@T0@@He et&nbsp;al. (2016)@@T1@@ &mdash.zh: @@T0@@He 等人（2016）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Identity Mappings in Deep Residual Networks.@@T3@@ 预激活变体。
@@T0@@He et&nbsp;al. (2016)@@T1@@ &mdash.src: He et al. (2016) — Identity Mappings in Deep Residual Networks. Pre-activation variant.

@@T0@@Veit, Wilber, Belongie (2016)@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@Veit, Wilber, Belongie（2016）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Residual Networks Behave Like Ensembles of Relatively Shallow Networks.@@T3@@ “路径的指数级集成”这一解读。
@@T0@@Veit, Wilber, Belongie (2016)@@T1@.src: Veit, Wilber, Belongie (2016) — Residual Networks Behave Like Ensembles of Relatively Shallow Networks. The "exponential ensemble of paths" interpretation.

@@T0@@Elhage et&nbsp;al. (2021)@@T1@@ &m.zh: @@T0@@Elhage 等人（2021）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits.@@T3@@ 残差流视角。
@@T0@@Elhage et&nbsp;al. (2021)@@T1@@ &m.src: Elhage et al. (2021) — A Mathematical Framework for Transformer Circuits. The residual stream view.

@@T0@@Dong, Cordonnier, Loukas (2021)@@T.zh: @@T0@@Dong, Cordonnier, Loukas（2021）@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Attention is Not All You Need: Pure Attention Loses Rank Doubly Exponentially with Depth.@@T3@@
@@T0@@Dong, Cordonnier, Loukas (2021)@@T.src: Dong, Cordonnier, Loukas (2021) — Attention is Not All You Need: Pure Attention Loses Rank Doubly Exponentially with Depth.

meta.title: 残差连接为何有效
meta.tagline: 观察一个 50 层网络在无跳跃连接时如何衰亡，又如何一键痊愈
meta.summary: 在 L = 4、16、64 层处训练极小的网络，开启或关闭残差开关。观察激活如何随深度爆炸或消失，观察损失曲面如何由崎岖变得平滑，并理解为何一个单行的架构技巧能让网络加深 100 倍而不致失效。随后进入使 Transformer 得以运转的残差流视角。
highlights: 在浏览器中训练结构相同、带或不带跳跃连接的 L 层网络；观察 L=64 的普通网络停滞而残差网络持续前进。
逐层激活量级的实时展示 — 观察其在无跳跃连接时呈指数式崩塌，在有跳跃连接时趋于稳定。
损失曲面二维切片的有无残差对比：崎岖的普通景观与平滑的残差景观（Li 等人，2018，交互形式）。
将 ResNet 与 Transformer 编码器联系起来的残差流视角。
